brief: Need a logo for "Lumen Yoga", a small yoga studio in Austin. Minimal, calm, earthy colors. Just the logo, budget $60, need it ASAP.

analysis.summary_zh: 光芒瑜伽，在Austin，为瑜伽爱好者提供宁静和舒适的空间。

cases.title: 缇莫拉 TIMORA · 草本大健康品牌
cases.desc: 两片草本叶子相拥成一个太极圆，一青一金，寓意阴阳调和、内外平衡，也对应品牌的两条产品线。黛青代表草本与健康，暖金代表品质与温度；中文用端正的宋体风格字，英文 TIMORA 用古典衬线体，适合礼盒包装、电商主图和门店。

cases.title: 钰山商贸 · 商贸企业标志（完整交付）
cases.desc: 「钰」从金从玉，代表珍贵与诚信；标志用玉石绿山峦做主体，峰顶嵌一颗切面宝石，表示品质立于高处，金色弧线像向上延伸的通路，寓意贸易流通、事业攀升。主色玉石绿 #08785C 搭配暖金 #C89850，稳重又有价值感。交付竖版、横版、单色绿、单色黑、反白版和独立图标，提供 SVG / PNG（含透明底）/ PDF，门头、名片、包装袋都能直接用。

bid_zh:
尊敬的客户，

我叫Hongpeng，是一位独立自由的设计师，为 Lumen Yoga 提供Logo设计服务。

Lumen Yoga是一家专注于瑜伽工作室的品牌，我理解您对品牌形象的重视。我为您设计一个简约、自然、充满地球气息的Logo，风格以Minimal主义为主，营造平静、舒适的氛围。

我的设计理念是利用有机元素，例如草本植物，来体现瑜伽的自然和纯粹。 针对缇莫拉 TIMORA 和钰山商贸的案例，我已准备好一份报价为¥389，预计3天内完成初稿，并包含2次修改机会。 期待与您合作，共同打造一个令人愉悦的品牌形象。

敬请期待，

Hongpeng
bid_en:
Subject: Logo Design Proposal - Lumen Yoga

Dear Lumen Yoga,

I’m Hongpeng, a freelance logo designer. I’ve reviewed your project for Lumen Yoga and believe a minimalist, calming logo would be a great fit. My style leans towards earthy organic elements, reflecting your studio’s focus on yoga.

Based on my portfolio (available at Lumen Yoga), I’ve estimated a price of $55 for a first draft. I’ll deliver initial drafts within 3 days and provide two revision rounds. I’m committed to delivering a polished result.

Sincerely,

Hongpeng
checklist:
- [ ] Vector Logo (AI): Scalable vector file (AI) – 300 DPI, various sizes (100x100, 200x200, 300x300, 500x500).
- [ ] Raster Logo (PNG): High-resolution PNG – 300 DPI, for web & print.
- [ ] Color Palette (PSD): Primary & Secondary Colors – 4 variations (RGB, CMYK, HEX).
- [ ] Logo Variations (JPG):  Horizontal & Vertical versions – 1:1, 1:2, 1:3.
- [ ] Font Selection (Font File):  “Lumen” font – 100% weight and style.
- [ ] Logo Markup (XML):  For potential application in digital marketing.
- [ ] Logo Mockup (PNG):  A simple mockup showcasing the logo in a yoga studio setting (e.g., wall background).
- [ ] Logo Style Guide (PDF): Basic guidelines for logo usage – color, size, spacing, etc. (Basic - no detailed design elements).
prompts:
1.  **“Glowing Root”:** Generate an image of a stylized, abstracted root system emerging from a smooth, rounded stone, bathed in soft, diffused light.
2.  **“Slow Sunrise”:** Create a minimalist illustration of a single, gentle sun rising over a cluster of moss-covered rocks, conveying a sense of peaceful awakening.
3.  **“Flowing Light”:** Illustrate a single, delicate leaf gently unfurling, with light radiating outwards, suggesting movement and growth.
